tools.title: FreeMcBoot 1.966
tools.description: Memory-card boot menu for launching PS2 homebrew. Use a compatible console and card; late SCPH-900xx units with boot ROM 2.30 or newer and PS2 TV cannot start FMCB directly.
tools.imageAlt: Free McBoot project logo and developer credits

tools.title: OpenTuna installer
tools.description: Memory-card browser exploit for supported Fat and Slim PS2 systems, including later Slims that cannot autoboot FMCB. The project lists SCPH-18000 through SCPH-90010 and PS2 TV. Back up the card: installation deletes existing APPS, FORTUNA and OPENTUNA folders.

tools.title: Open PS2 Loader
tools.description: Game and ELF application loader with USB, network and internal-HDD options, virtual memory cards and controller features. Storage support depends on your hardware and build; this download is the stable 1.1.0 release.

tools.title: wLaunchELF
tools.description: File browser and ELF launcher for memory cards, USB and other supported PS2 storage. Includes a text editor, hard-drive management and FTP support. The linked BOOT.ELF is an upstream development build.
tools.imageAlt: Example LaunchELF 4.43a menu in the Play! emulator

tools.title: Apollo Save Tool · PS2
tools.description: Manage PS2 and PS1 saves, import or export supported save formats, work with virtual memory cards and apply supported save patches. Keep original saves before editing or restoring them.
tools.imageAlt: Apollo Save Tool PS2 main menu screenshot

tools.title: PS2Ident
tools.description: Inspect console identifiers, ROM versions and hardware information. The retail-console build also supports creating dumps from your own system for research; the separate PS2TOOL and desktop database builds are different downloads.
tools.imageAlt: Official blue circuit-board background used by PS2Ident
